violation_type.title: NYC Health Code §81.17(d)(1)
violation_type.typical_finding: Food establishment shall Not use damaged equipment that is cracked chipped rusted or corroded or cannot be readily cleaned and sanitized; cutting blocks and boards re-surfaced or replaced when needed.
